anime_multiverse.skill.faith_of_femto.de: Unique, evolves into Femto, Falcon of Light once mastered. Ambition, sacrifice and the Eclipse. Griffith, the White Falcon, wills the sacrifice of the Band of the Falcon at the Eclipse and is reborn as Femto, fifth of the God Hand, the angels of desire who carry out the will of the Idea of Evil. After the Incarnation Ceremony he returns as the Falcon of Light. He bends space and gravity, repels blows, and no blade of the physical world can harm him. Worship: Faith is the Falcon's following: the dream of the Falcon of Light and the Band that gave itself at the Eclipse. The Eclipse asks a willed sacrifice, so it needs at least 2 worshippers. Limit: Nothing is gained without sacrifice: Eclipse costs 4 Faith and needs 2 worshippers. Canon says he is not absolute against those outside his story; that is not modelled. Passives (one ON/OFF switch): Wings of Darkness. Actives: Band of the Falcon (open), Eclipse (opens at 25 percent mastery), Gravity Well (opens at 50 percent mastery).

anime_multiverse.skill.faith_of_lucifero: Unique, evolves into Lucifero, King of Devils once mastered. Gravity and the underworld. Lucifero is a highest-ranking devil joined to the Tree of Qliphoth, one of the three rulers of the underworld and King of Devils. A devil cannot enter the living world without a gate: Forbidden Magic and a sacrifice call one, and a host can wield only as much power as the gate lets through. He bends gravity, warps space and seizes lesser devils. Anti Magic harms him. Worship: Faith is the gate: worshippers open the gates of the underworld. Under 3 worshippers the first gate gives x0.7, 3 to 5 give x1.0, 6 or more give x1.3 (no linear devotion). Limit: The gate caps the power a host can wield. Canon: Anti Magic hurts him; that is not modelled. Passives (one ON/OFF switch): Immense Durability. Actives: Gravity Prostration (open), Space Warp (opens at 25 percent mastery), Half Manifestation (opens at 50 percent mastery).

Unique, evolves into Luminus, Lord of Radiance once mastered. Holy light, faith and grace. Luminous Valentine, queen of the vampires and a Demon Lord, is worshipped as the one God of Luminism by the Western Holy Church. Her Secret of Faith and Grace turns believers' faith into holy magic, and Sanctuary borrows the minds of her followers, so the more believers the greater the power. Her skill Lust became Asmodeus and then Ahura Mazda, Lord of Radiance. Worship: Secret of Faith and Grace: faith is her holy magic and Sanctuary borrows her followers' minds, so each worshipper adds 1.5 times the normal devotion. Limit: Sanctuary needs 3 worshippers and long preparation (90 s). Canon: Holy Field does nothing against holy beings; not modelled. Passives (one ON/OFF switch): Godspeed Regeneration. Actives: Holy Field (open), High Heal (opens at 25 percent mastery), Energy Drain (opens at 50 percent mastery).

anime_multiverse.skill.faith_of_mavis.de: Unique, evolves into Mavis, the Fairy Tactician once mastered. Bonds and the guild. Mavis Vermillion, the First Master of Fairy Tail, is the guild's founder and guardian, not a god: her body sleeps inside the Fairy Heart and her thought projection watches over it. Fairy Sphere turns the members' bonds and faith into magic power, Fairy Law strikes only those the caster truly sees as enemies, Fairy Glitter is a merciless light gathered from sun, moon and stars. Worship: Fairy Sphere converts the members' bonds and faith into magic power and needs other members' power in unison: it needs 2 worshippers. Limit: Fairy Law costs the caster's life for every foe beyond the first (4 percent of max health each, at most 24 percent, never below 1 heart). Passives (one ON/OFF switch): Fairy Heart. Actives: Tenrou Illusion (open), Fairy Sphere (opens at 25 percent mastery), Fairy Law (opens at 50 percent mastery).

anime_multiverse.skill.faith_of_ill_ilah: Unique, evolves into Ill Ilah, the Black God once mastered. The Rukh and fate. Ill Ilah, the Black God, is the will-less lump of power that made Alma Torran, gave humans magic and takes every soul back into the Rukh. Al-Thamen worship it and draw it down through the Black Spot with black rukh born of hatred. Touching the surface of the world, it drains magoi from every living thing. Solomon sealed it away. Worship: Al-Thamen worship it and feed the Black Spot with black rukh; the god itself has no will, so its faith is plain devotion. Limit: Black Spot costs 4 Faith. Canon: the god can be sealed again; not modelled. Passives (one ON/OFF switch): Great Flow. Actives: Rukh's Guidance (open), Gift of Magic (opens at 25 percent mastery), Magoi Drain (opens at 50 percent mastery).

anime_multiverse.skill.faith_of_super_sa: Unique, evolves into Super Saiyan Blue once mastered. Divine ki. Six righteous Saiyans pour their ki into one of them, who rises as the Super Saiyan God: crimson hair, a calm mind, godly ki that others can hardly sense. The form drains the body and ends after a short time until it is mastered. Trained further, the Saiyan keeps its power in the natural body and joins it to Super Saiyan as Super Saiyan Blue. Worship: The ritual needs six righteous Saiyans: the ritual refuses with fewer than 5 worshippers beside the target. Their shared ki is the Ritual of Six. Limit: Until mastered the form tires the body (weakness). Canon: a short time limit; here it is the weakness, which ends at mastery. Passives (one ON/OFF switch): Divine Ki. Actives: Ritual of Six (open), Invisible Palm Blast (opens at 25 percent mastery), Aura of a God (opens at 50 percent mastery).

anime_multiverse.skill.faith_of_ra.descr: Unique, evolves into Ra, the Winged Dragon once mastered. The sun and tribute. The Winged Dragon of Ra, golden Egyptian God, can be called only by the chosen Pharaoh with three Tributes. Its God Blaze Cannon is fed with life points paid by the summoner, its Phoenix Mode burns as a flaming bird, and in Sphere Mode it is a golden orb. No spell or trap can pick it out. Worship: Three Tributes call Ra (the ritual offering is 3 gold blocks) and the god's power is paid in life points: Point-to-Point Transfer burns your own health for damage. Limit: Point-to-Point Transfer costs 30 percent of your health (never below 1 heart) for up to x1.6 damage. Passives (one ON/OFF switch): Divine Immunity. Actives: Sphere Mode (open), God Blaze Cannon (opens at 25 percent mastery), Point-to-Point Transfer (opens at 50 percent mastery).

anime_multiverse.skill.faith_of_aqua.des: Unique, evolves into Aqua, Goddess of Water once mastered. Water, healing and the Axis Order. Aqua, goddess of water and patron of the Axis Order, fell to the mortal world as an Arch Priest. Her power follows the devotion of her followers, she heals, purifies, dispels and even resurrects, but her attacks only hurt demons and the undead. She walks on water, breathes under it and turns what she touches into holy water. Worship: As a goddess her power correlates to the devotion of her followers: base strength x0.7, each worshipper counts double. Limit: Her attacks are effective only against the undead (x1.6), weak against everything else (x0.6). Weakened after the fall: base x0.7. Passives (one ON/OFF switch): Divine Protection. Actives: Heal (open), Purification (opens at 25 percent mastery), Turn Undead (opens at 50 percent mastery).
